A little preview of what I’ve been up to 

I finally started VLOGGINGGG 

And if you think my little clips over here are chaotic… imagine me with an entire vlog lmao.

Vlog #1 is up now and we’re just getting started.

Salon days, DIYing my new suite, transformations, extensions, shopping trips, behind the scenes + whatever other shit I get myself into 

The longer version is waiting for youuu 

 in bio 

#HausOfMo #SalonVlog #HairstylistLife #BehindTheChair SalonOwner

DIY MY SALON SUITE, DAY 3 At this point, if I don’t like it… I’m redoing it. The cabinet wrap started lifting on the corners, so I went back in with contact adhesive because absolutely notttt. Then I finally hung up my Haus of Mo sign ANDDDD I re-wrapped my countertops because the first contact paper was too short and left a seam… and once I noticed it, it was literally all I could see. So naturally, we ripped it off and did it again. AND MY FRONT DOOR SIGN CAME INNNN Haus of Mo is officially looking like HAUS OF MO. Also, I genuinely cannot thank y’all enough for shopping off my Amazon wishlist. Every package that shows up makes me want to cry. The fact that y’all are helping me build this space and following along while I DIY this entire suite means SO MUCH to me. If you want to help me finish the Haus, my Amazon wishlist is linked in my bio Day 4 coming because apparently I have decided to renovate an entire salon suite one Reel at a time #DIYSalonSuite #SalonSuiteMakeover #HausOfMo #SalonOwner #SalonSuite

WHO BOUGHT ME THE NESPRESSO 

Because I need you to know I am FREAKING OUTTTT. 

Amazon keeps y’all anonymous so I have no idea who sent this to me, but THANK YOU. Seriously. The fact that you guys are watching me DIY this new suite and actually want to be a part of it means so much to me.

And whoever you are… just know you are personally responsible for me being WAY too caffeinated at the salon now 

I’m so excited to get it set up in the new Haus. 

My Amazon wishlist is linked in my bio, OR comment HAUS and I’ll send you the link! 

@nespresso @amazon 

#HausOfMo #SalonSuite #SalonSuiteMakeover #SalonOwner #NashvilleStylist

Olaplex UNBOXING!! 

The new N°7 shine spray is to DIE for. 

Thank you OLAPLEX 

#prunboxing #olaplex #hair #hausofmo #hairstylist

DIY My New Suite | Day 3 

Today was all about the not-so-glam side of owning a salon. Cleaned up the suite, got everything prepped for State Board, and started building out my retail shelves!

Slowly but surely, Haus of Mo is coming together exactly how I’ve envisioned it. 

Retail is officially starting to make its way in:
• Framar brushes
• OLAPLEX Shampoo + Conditioner
• K18 Hair Hair Heat Protectant
• Kenra Professional blow out spray

It’s still a work in progress, but seeing everything come together makes me so excited for what’s next.

If you’ve been following along and want to help me build my dream salon suite, I do have an Amazon wishlist! It’s linked in my bio!

#HausOfMo #SalonSuiteDIY #NashvilleHairStylist #SalonSuiteLife #SmallBusinessJourney

You guys are seriously the sweetest. 

Someone purchased this towel warmer from my Amazon wishlist and I don’t think you understand how excited I am. It’s one of those little things that makes the salon experience feel a little more luxurious for my clients.

We’re slowly building Haus of Mo together, one Amazon package at a time, and I am SO grateful for every single person following along on this journey. 

Now excuse me while I find excuses to put a warm towel on everyone that sits in my chair. 

Comment “HAUS” if you’d like the link to my Amazon wishlist!

#HausOfMo #SalonSuite #SmallBusinessOwner #HairStylist

DIY MY SUITE: DAY 2 

Today’s progress:
• Rehung my floating shelf because apparently 4 inches makes ALL the difference. 
• Wrapped my cabinets in a warm wood finish.
• Hung my shampoo bar shelves!

Shout out to OLAPLEX & Schwarzkopf Professional USA being my 2 main treatments in salon! 

This space is finally starting to feel like Haus of Mo, and I still have SO many ideas left for it.

If you’d like to help bring my dream suite to life, I put together an Amazon wishlist with all the little things I’m still needing! 

Comment HAUS and I’ll send you the links!

Stay tuned for Day 3. 

#DIYSalonSuite #HausOfMo #SalonSuiteMakeover #NashvilleHairStylist #SalonSuiteLife

POV: You finally outgrow your salon suite… so you build your dream one instead. Day 1 is officially done! We wrapped the countertops, installed black concrete wallpaper, and got my floating station shelf and mirror up. (Don’t worry… you’ll see me redo part of it on Day 2.) I have SO many ideas for this space, and I’m taking you along for every step of the transformation. A few of you have already asked if there’s anything you can do to help, so I’m putting together an Amazon wishlist with décor, client experience upgrades, and salon essentials. There is absolutely no expectation, just watching, sharing, and cheering me on means more than you know. I seriously cannot wait to show you what Haus of Mo becomes. #salonsuite #salonmakeover #hairtok #nashvillehairstylist #hausofmo

Why can’t I remember to take before and afters for everyone guys 

Saturday 8/11 wedding. 6 beautiful bridesmaids. SUCH a fun wedding party. 

I LOVE WEDDINGS. Booking for fall 2026 & 2027 books are now open! 

#weddings #bridal #weddingmakeup #bridalmakeup #nashvillemua
